restaurant.name: The Sample Table
restaurant.notice: Sample content. This restaurant, its dishes and prices are invented for the demo. The dish images are computer-generated.

dishes.name: Burrata & heirloom tomatoes
dishes.summary: Creamy burrata, ripe tomatoes, basil, olive oil.
dishes.description: A whole burrata torn open at the table, surrounded by heirloom tomatoes in five colours, torn basil, cracked black pepper and a pool of cold-pressed olive oil.

dishes.name: Sliced steak & frites
dishes.summary: Grilled sirloin, herb butter sauce, crisp fries.
dishes.description: Sirloin grilled medium and sliced, finished with a warm herb-butter sauce. Served with a generous pile of thin, crisp fries and extra sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Smash cheeseburger
dishes.summary: Beef patty, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, brioche.
dishes.description: A thick beef patty with melted cheddar, crisp lettuce and tomato on a toasted sesame brioche bun. Comes on a board with fries and house ketchup.

dishes.name: Roasted salmon & asparagus
dishes.description: Salmon fillet roasted with an herb crust, served with grilled asparagus, a lemon wedge, citrus emulsion and microgreens.

dishes.name: Spaghetti al pomodoro
dishes.description: Spaghetti twirled in a slow-cooked tomato sauce, topped with fresh basil and shaved aged parmesan.

dishes.name: Chocolate dome
dishes.summary: Dark chocolate mousse, raspberries, gold leaf.
dishes.description: Dark chocolate mousse under a mirror glaze, set on a hazelnut sablé, with fresh raspberries, mint, a raspberry coulis swoosh and a few flakes of gold leaf.

dishes.name: House lemonade
dishes.description: Freshly squeezed lemons, a little cane sugar and mint, topped with sparkling water.

dishes.name: Peach iced tea
dishes.summary: Black tea brewed cold with peach.
dishes.description: Black tea cold-brewed overnight with white peach, lightly sweetened and served over ice.
